alternatives: partial-release — considered and rejected: SP-9.1 allows partial release only where received quantity covers the committed build and material can be released; receipt shows qc_status = 'fail' for the shipment (no accepted qty reported), so no QA-passing quantity is available to release.

escalate-to-buyer — considered and rejected as primary action: SP-7.1 directs that material failing incoming inspection is held and not released; buyer escalation is not mandated unless supplier dispute or corrective action/chargeback is required.
